 Simpkins Speaker Series Goes Bananas: Savannah Bananas President to Present
October 21, 2026 
 The Eastern Florida State College Foundation has announced that Jared Orton, president
 of the renowned Savannah Bananas will be featured as its Fall 2026 Simpkins Speaker
 Series headliner.
 This FREE event is open to the public and will be held on Monday, Nov. 9 beginning
 at 10:45 a.m. on the EFSC Melbourne Campus at the Bldg. 16, Student Union, in the
 2nd floor conference center. The Melbourne Campus is located at 3865 Wickham Road,
 Melbourne, FL 32935.
 At the heart of the Savannah Bananas' success is a simple belief: if you take care
 of the fans, the fans will take care of the brand. That philosophy has shaped everything
 from the in-stadium experience and entertainment to the way the organization builds
 its culture, creates content, and connects with people around the world.
 This “Fans First Experience” has helped cultivate a culture where ordinary moments
 become extraordinary memories, employees are empowered to create, and every decision
 starts with one question: What would make this better for the fan?
 In his keynote, Orton shares the lessons, mindset, and practical principles behind
 building a fans first culture and how an unwavering commitment to creating an experience
 people love can turn a local organization into a global phenomenon.
 For more information, visit foundation.easternflorida.edu/simpkins-speaker-series/ or call 321-433-7055.
